title: Crystal Clicker
description: Mine deep into a crystal geode! Tap to harvest shards, buy upgrades, and discover rare gems. A meditative mining idle game.
detailedDescription: Descend into a luminous crystal geode where every tap fractures another shard from the walls. Start with a simple pickaxe and work your way up to auto-mining drills, resonance amplifiers, and gem-sorting conveyors. Discover rare crystals — amethyst, citrine, aquamarine, and the legendary starlight gem — each with unique bonus effects. Prestige to unlock permanent multipliers and deeper cavern layers. The idle progression is satisfying whether you're actively tapping or checking in between tasks.
controls: Click or tap to mine crystals. Buy upgrades from the shop panel. Auto-miners will continue producing while you're away. Prestige when progress slows to reset with permanent bonuses.
